about: Answer key for the Noisefloor demo tests: what each test was designed to do. Test identity is (suite, classname, test_name); the suite is the JUnit suite name the Jenkins job sets for this folder. fail_rate is the share of builds in which the test fails by design. For order dependence it is the chance that the leaking test runs first in the shuffled order.
seed: Outcomes are seeded from BUILD_NUMBER (or NOISEFLOOR_DEMO_SEED), so a build number always gives the same results.

tests.cause: timing race: a fixed 50 ms sleep instead of waiting for the background job
leaks state into a module-level cache, but always passes itself
order dependence: fails when the cart-saving test ran before it
random data: an off-by-one at the 10, 15 and 20 item tiers (3 of 20 quantities)
slow dependency: the stub service sometimes answers after the 150 ms timeout
time zones: the date is taken in UTC, which is wrong from 18:30 UTC (330 of 1440 minutes)
random data: names longer than 21 characters are cut (9 of 30 lengths)

tests.slows_down_at_commit: refactor(demo): load order items with one query per order
refactor(demo): turn off the product search cache
refactor(demo): retry tax service calls with a fixed back-off
